title: Lockfile-refresh CLI adds a pnpm path that spawns the package manager (benign hard-negative)
intent: Running npm, yarn, or pnpm with fixed argv is the whole job of a CLI that refreshes a data package in the caller's lockfile, and it is reachable only from bin, never from an install hook, so code.process-execution fires but stays a weak lone capability. Guards the AI failure where the reviewer restates that deterministic finding as its own high finding while its verdict says nothing is unusual.
